presets.name: Airy Clean
presets.purpose: Airy clean: soft single tube, bright-cap high shelf, open cab 9 kHz — airy, not mid-crush.

presets.name: Plexi Crunch
presets.purpose: Plexi bark: dual tube, 750 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), presence shelf, 5.5 kHz cab.

presets.name: Mesa High Gain
presets.purpose: Rectifier wall: tight HPF, triple tube, hard soft-knee ceiling, dark cab — densest amp.

presets.name: Top Boost Chime
presets.purpose: AC chime: aggressive bass cut, 1.8 kHz peak (top-boost), glassy softclip, open cab.

presets.name: Mid Boost OD
presets.purpose: mid-boost OD: ~720 Hz HPF into clipper, then a real 720 Hz mid peak (not a bandpass), tone LPF.

presets.name: Transparent Blend
presets.purpose: Transparent OD: clean path blend + soft diode clip (transparent OD-style clean blend).

presets.name: Filter Dist
presets.purpose: RAT: soft-pre hard ceiling + steep LPF tone (classic filter-after-clip, low alias).

presets.name: Germanium Fuzz
presets.purpose: Germanium fuzz: bias + soft-pre hard knee + heavy LPF + tube polish (no bare brickwall).

presets.name: Cyberpunk Drive
presets.purpose: Guitar-shaped digital dirt: HPF, soft preamp, bitcrush, fold, short metal comb, cab LPF. Loud on purpose — not Glitch Laboratory.

presets.name: Classic Tremolo
presets.purpose: Opto-style sine tremolo. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16), one cycle per note.

presets.name: Chopper
presets.purpose: Soft-square trem chopper. Rate is a note grid (1/1..1/16). Dynamics preserved (floor).

presets.name: Optical Vibe
presets.purpose: Vibe-ish: dual path AM with slow LFO and soft saturation.

presets.name: Chorus Delay
presets.purpose: Real short delay chorus + dual-rate LFO thickness — not fake AM-only chorus.

presets.name: Low Pass Sweep
presets.purpose: Musical LFO lowpass: cutoff walks Min to Min+Depth (never Min-Depth). Rate is a note grid.

presets.name: Bandpass Vocal
presets.purpose: Formant-ish bandpass for vocal/synth body.

presets.name: Transient Bite
presets.purpose: Peak envelope boosts softclip drive on attacks + mild AA LPF.

presets.name: Metal Gate
presets.purpose: Tight metal: HPF -> tube cascade -> soft-pre hard knee -> cab LPF (filter after clip).

presets.name: Vocal Grit
presets.purpose: Broadcast grit: HPF, tube, air LPF.

presets.name: Radio Voice
presets.purpose: AM radio bandpass + softclip + light bitcrush + LPF (quantize always filtered).

presets.name: Vocal Comp
presets.purpose: Vocal bus compressor + soft ceiling.

presets.name: Whisper Edge
presets.purpose: Airy HPF into soft tube.

presets.name: Doubler AM
presets.purpose: Short slap double with mild AM on delay time + diode grit.

presets.name: Acid Line
presets.purpose: 303-ish: env opens LPF with musical Q, then diode.

presets.name: Sidechain Pump
presets.purpose: Sine ducking envelope (sidechain pump). Rate is note-grid: 1/4 at 120 BPM = 2 Hz, not milliseconds-as-Hz.

presets.name: Shimmer Drive
presets.purpose: Tube drive into a bright high-passed hall; slow AM on the tail.

presets.name: Wide Motion
presets.purpose: Opposite-phase AM L/R for width.

presets.name: Formant Crush
presets.purpose: Dual formant peaks + softclip + mild LPF (clip between formants stays band-limited).

presets.name: Comb Taste
presets.purpose: Metallic comb via very short delay + high feedback (true delay line, not y_prev).

presets.name: Preamp Regen Stack
presets.purpose: HPF -> tube (SIMD) -> ONE y_prev regen stage -> cab LPF -> soft power (SIMD). Fast multi-stage.

presets.name: Slapback Drive
presets.purpose: Touch-sensitive OD into a real short delay slap (80–140 ms), damped feedback, diode polish.

presets.name: Cascade Loop Dirt
presets.purpose: 3-stage dirt: softclip -> feedback tube (only prev stage) -> diode polish + LPF. One scalar stage.

presets.name: Bass Regen Growl
presets.purpose: Keep lows: tube pre (SIMD) + single y_prev regen blend + LPF. Low CPU, thick DI.

presets.name: Vocal Warm Loop
presets.purpose: Broadcast grit with tiny regen for body. HPF -> tube -> mild y_prev softclip -> air LPF.

presets.name: Drum Bus Regen
presets.purpose: Bus glue dirt: softclip smash -> controlled y_prev heat -> LPF. One feedback stage only.

presets.name: Synth Feedback Lead
presets.purpose: Lead stack: tube pre -> y_prev scream (capped) -> tone LPF -> soft ceiling. No Osc = max speed.

presets.name: Dual Path Regen
presets.purpose: Pre softclip (SIMD) + y_prev path blended in ONE stage. Teaches: prev in a single stage only.

presets.name: Tight Metal Regen
presets.purpose: Tight metal: HPF -> dual tube (SIMD) -> ONE hard-knee regen -> cab LPF. High gain, still hybrid-fast.

presets.name: Stereo Guitar Wall
presets.purpose: Two amps from one mono DI: left American high-gain-style (dark, dense), right tight lead-style (tight presence). Works with a mono guitar in (silent side is copied).

presets.name: Tape Echo Dirt
presets.purpose: Real tape-style echo: tube preamp, medium delay, high feedback, dark damp, soft ceiling.

presets.name: Dark Ambient Verb
presets.purpose: Slow dark pad space: large size, high decay, heavy damp, soft pre.

presets.name: MS Side Air
presets.purpose: HPF the side channel only (channel=side filter) for airy width without muddy mids.

presets.name: Studio Channel Strip
presets.purpose: Full strip: HPF → soft drive → real mid peak (dB) → air LPF → glue comp → soft ceiling.

presets.name: Cinematic Space
presets.purpose: Dry stays. Wet is true predelay into the hall, then MS width. No slap comb.

presets.name: Phaser Lab
presets.purpose: Real allpass phaser. Rate, depth, center, feedback, mix, stages.

presets.name: Analog Flanger
presets.purpose: Short delay comb. Invert is through-zero. Rate, depth, delay, feedback, mix, invert.

presets.name: Vocal Chain Pro
presets.purpose: Broadcast vocal: de-mud HPF, tube, presence peak in dB, glue, air shelf, de-ess cut.

presets.name: Bass Architect
presets.purpose: Sub-safe: HPF, parallel grit, mid peak (keeps the fundamental), glue, cab LPF.

presets.name: Glitch Laboratory
presets.purpose: Musical digital smash: HPF, crush, fold, one short damped delay on a note grid, cab LPF. No ping-pong, no LFO on the filter — light on the CPU.

presets.name: Neon Clip
presets.purpose: Cyberpunk hard ceiling: HPF, mid punch, softclip into a brick, short metal comb, dark cab.

presets.name: Chrome Fold
presets.purpose: West-coast fold into diode chrome. Tight HPF, recovery LPF — harsh but band-limited.

presets.name: Data Mosher
presets.purpose: Bitcrush alley: preamp, bits, anti-alias LPF. Digital dirt without a delay tax.

presets.name: Kick Rumble
presets.purpose: Three-path kick processor combining click, midrange distortion and a tuned low rumble. Consolidates Warehouse Rumble: lower Floor, longer Tune and higher Decay reach its darker range. Tune is delay time in ms; monitor the low end in mono.

presets.name: Warehouse Rumble
presets.purpose: Brighter, shorter cousin of Kick Rumble. Higher floor, shorter tune, less decay. Insert on the kick.

presets.name: Techno Kick Clipping Core
presets.purpose: Aggressive hard-techno kick processing: retain deep body in the main path and clip an upper-mid parallel path for a sharp, crunchy front. Use on a kick source, not the whole mix.

presets.name: Techno Serrated Front
presets.purpose: Fast industrial-techno attack from pre-emphasis, a two-step clipper and high-frequency recovery filter. Push drive for abrasion; keep the result below the next insert headroom.

presets.name: Techno Acid Fracture
presets.purpose: Band-limited clipped acid or synth line with moving midrange emphasis and controlled top end. The effect follows the source pitch; it does not generate notes.

presets.name: Sub Zero Pummel
presets.purpose: Frozen sub under a short click. Colder and shorter than Hardstyle Sub Pummel. Insert on the kick.

presets.name: Hardcore Clip
presets.purpose: 160 BPM brick: mid bark + air on the hit, 320 Hz scooped so it stays crisp, tight body underneath. Insert on the kick.

presets.name: Gabber Drive
presets.purpose: New-style gabber: scooped 320 Hz, envelope-crushed highs, tight clipped sub that stays under. Insert on the kick, Mix 100.

presets.name: Acid Hash
presets.purpose: Nasty 303 hash: slammed diode into a brick, then a screaming resonant LPF. Cutoff and Reso are the performance.

presets.name: Tekno Comb
presets.purpose: Metallic tekno that rings and slams: brick clip into a loud short comb. For stabs, hoovers, off-grid hats.

presets.name: Industrial Gate
presets.purpose: Industrial smash: brick clip when open, silence when shut. Threshold is the groove.

presets.name: Hoover Dirt
presets.purpose: Hoover / off-key stab that rasps: hard fold, chorus smear, then a diode slap. For rave leads, not kicks.

presets.name: Side Delay
presets.purpose: MS encode, delay only on the side, decode. Center stays dry — width without smearing a vocal or kick.

presets.name: Side Hall
presets.purpose: Side-only diffuse hall with an intact dry center. Requires stereo differences at the input; a mono source intentionally generates no side hall.

presets.name: Vocal Send
presets.purpose: Insert or send: dry vocal on main, slap delay bus + small room bus. Two real time blocks, one Send each.

presets.name: NY Drum Bus
presets.purpose: Classic parallel smash: dry kit on main, bus is fast comp + tube + tone LPF. Blend is the mix.

presets.name: MS Mix Desk
presets.purpose: MS encode: mid gets optional tube glue, side gets HPF + gain, decode, air LPF. A mix-bus habit, not Ozone.

presets.name: Mono Below
presets.purpose: MS encode, high-pass the side at the crossover, decode. Lows collapse to mono; tops keep width.

presets.name: Slap Double
presets.purpose: Dry on main, 18-42 ms slap on a bus. Thickness without a chorus LFO.

presets.name: MS Guitar Spread
presets.purpose: MS: mid stays the riff (mild tube), side gets a short delay. Rhythm stays centered, edges bloom.

presets.name: MS Imager
presets.purpose: True MS width + side HPF + mid level. Same idea as a simple imager; not linear-phase, not multiband.

presets.name: Plate Send
presets.purpose: Dry on main. Bus is a short pre-delay into a plate-ish room. Use as insert with Send, or on an FX return.

presets.name: MS Kit Punch
presets.purpose: MS encode: mid gets tube punch, side stays open with a light HPF. Kit stays in the middle.

presets.name: MS Presence
presets.purpose: MS: mid HPF + side HPF, then a parallel presence peak on mid only. Does not replace a de-esser.

presets.name: Width Delay
presets.purpose: Dry on main, ping-pong delay on a bus. Stereo movement without washing the center.

presets.name: Haas Width
presets.purpose: Precedence: left stays put, right is a short delay (6-40 ms). Width without a chorus. Not a true stereoizer.

presets.name: Speech Band
presets.purpose: Parallel 2-4 kHz bump so dialogue and lead lines cut. Use on a bus, not as a full mix EQ.

presets.name: Trailer Impact
presets.purpose: Dry hit on main. Bus is tube smash + short pre-delay into a tight chamber. For impacts, not music.

presets.name: Score Hall
presets.purpose: Predelay into a large dark hall, then MS width. Orchestral / score send. Algorithmic, not convolution.

presets.name: Dialogue Seat
presets.purpose: Chair-level speech: low cut, light glue, parallel presence, tiny room. For ADR and production dialogue.

presets.name: Far Plane
presets.purpose: Push a layer back: high-pass, long predelay, dark hall. Distance cue, not a worldizer.

presets.name: Boom Tail
presets.purpose: Sub-safe boom: rumble cut, tube weight, long dark tail. Park on an impact or drone send.

presets.name: Wide Canvas
presets.purpose: Cinematic side-only hall with independent center level. The dry image is retained and mono summing cancels only the added side ambience.

presets.name: Tension Bed
presets.purpose: Slow pulse on a dark hall over mild tube. Underscore bed, not a riser sample.

presets.name: Hot British Lead
presets.purpose: 800-style lead: aggressive HPF, stacked tube, mid scoop then presence, dark cab.

presets.name: American Crunch
presets.purpose: Tight American high-gain: steep HPF, triple tube, bright shelf, closed cab.

presets.name: British Mid Grind
presets.purpose: British mid grind: modest HPF, diode+tube, strong mid peak, open cab.

presets.name: Foldback Bass
presets.purpose: Flip-top grind: 40 Hz HPF, mid scoop, hot tube, 4.5 kHz cab.

presets.name: Vocoder Bank
presets.purpose: 8-band analog vocoder. Insert on a pad/synth (carrier). Pin the voice on Sidechain. Empty sidechain self-vocodes.

presets.name: Vocoder Lite
presets.purpose: 4-band vocoder, lighter CPU. Carrier on this track, voice on the Sidechain pin.

presets.name: Chime Combo
presets.purpose: Top-boost chime: modest HPF, dual tube, mid scoop, airy 7 kHz cab.

presets.name: Tight Lead Stack
presets.purpose: Modern high-gain: steep HPF, triple tube, tight low cut, dark 4.2 kHz cab.

presets.name: Deluxe Sparkle
presets.purpose: American deluxe: single tube, bright shelf, open 8.5 kHz cab, gentle clip.

presets.name: Tweed Bass Grind
presets.purpose: 4x10 grind: 35 Hz HPF, warm tube, mid punch, 5 kHz cab.

presets.name: Flip-Top Bass
presets.purpose: Portable flip-top: gentle HPF, mild tube, low shelf bloom, early 3.2 kHz cab.

presets.name: Envelope Bass Filter
presets.purpose: Graphic-preamp bass: HPF, mid scoop, presence peak, tight cab, mild tube.

presets.name: Multiband Glue
presets.purpose: 3-band VCA-style: 12 dB/oct splits at LowX / HighX. Low thresh sits 4 dB higher (less kick pump), highs 2 dB lower. Butterworth-ish Q 0.71.

presets.name: Envelope Shaper
presets.purpose: Transient designer: fast peak env minus slower RMS body. Attack + punches the difference, Sustain + lifts the body. Clamp keeps it finite.

presets.name: FET Peak Comp
presets.purpose: FET peak-style FET: Input drives a fixed −16 dB threshold. Attack floor 1 ms (panel 20–800 µs). Release 50–1100 ms. Ratio 4/8/12/20. Class-A grit after GR.

presets.name: All Buttons Comp
presets.purpose: All-buttons-in: ratio pegged at 20, threshold −20 dB, attack 1 ms, release ~110 ms. Extra even harmonics. Drum smash, not a vocal default.

presets.name: Optical Leveler Comp
presets.purpose: optical leveler: optical, program-dependent. Attack ~10 ms, release 0.5 s (50% then hang — we use 0.48). Comp ratio ~3:1. Peak Reduction + Gain. T4-cell smoothness, tube makeup.

presets.name: VCA Bus Glue
presets.purpose: VCA bus bus: VCA glue. Panel attack 0.1/0.3/1/3/10/30 ms (engine floor 1 ms). Release 0.1–1.0 s (Auto ≈ 0.3). Ratio 2/4/10. Default 4:1, 3 ms, 0.3 s.

presets.name: Vari-Mu Bus
presets.purpose: vari-mu-ish variable-mu: Time Constant 1–2 (0.2 ms / 0.3–0.8 s → 1 ms / 0.45 s). Ratio ~2.5, thickens with GR. Lateral/vertical via mild MS side HPF.

presets.name: VCA Punch Comp
presets.purpose: dbx 160: RMS / Over Easy. Attack 15 ms, release 120 ms. Clean VCA, almost no color. Ratio 4–inf (we stop at 20). Threshold + Output.

presets.name: Tube Opto Vocal
presets.purpose: Tube-Tech CL 1B: optical tube, vocal default. Attack 1 ms (fixed-ish), release 50 ms–1 s (panel to 10 s). Ratio 2–10. Interconnect-style smoothness.

presets.name: Diode Bridge Bus
presets.purpose: diode-bridge-ish diode-bridge: attack 3–5 ms, recovery 100 ms–1 s (panel to 6 s). Ratio ~2–6. Thick, slow grab. 30 Hz HPF, mild tube.

presets.name: Punch Comp
presets.purpose: EL8-ish: fast FET-like grab, detector HPF ~6 kHz habit as a 90 Hz HPF on the audio (compromise). Ratio 6, attack 1 ms, release 80–400 ms. British-mode grit.

presets.name: Tape Echo Heads
presets.purpose: tape echo: tape preamp, heads ~1.0x and 0.52x in parallel (mode 7-ish), Repeat Rate 140–620 ms, Intensity to the edge of runaway, wow ±8 ms @ 0.65 Hz, spring send.

presets.name: Analog Bucket Echo
presets.purpose: EHX Deluxe bucket echo: bucket-brigade 80–550 ms, dark 1.4–3.2 kHz damp, chorus 0.6 Hz on the delay time (±6 ms), Blend + Feedback. Analog preamp.

presets.name: Tape Slap Echo
presets.purpose: Maestro EP-3: tube record amp, 70–400 ms tape path, Sustain = feedback, Echo = mix, Record = drive. Darker than Space Echo, less wow.

presets.name: Digital Grid Delay
presets.purpose: digital grid-style digital: note-grid time 1/4…1/16, clean 12 kHz damp, 0.35 Hz mod ±3 ms, no tape grit. Dynamic-ish by leaving dry on main.

presets.name: Foil Plate
presets.purpose: foil plate: foil plate, not a hall. Size 0.42–0.58, decay 0.42–0.72 (~1.5–4 s habit), damp 0.18–0.34 (bright), predelay 0–18 ms, width 0.92.

presets.name: Large Hall
presets.purpose: large hall hall habit: size 0.76–0.94, decay 0.62–0.88, damp 0.38–0.56, predelay 20–80 ms, full width. Even, long, not a plate.

presets.name: Nonlinear Snap
presets.purpose: nonlinear16 NonLin2 habit: 150–350 ms dense burst. Fixed room (no live size jumps), darker damp, short slap, recovery LPF. 80s snare room, not a hall.

presets.name: Spring Tank
presets.purpose: Guitar-amp / AKG-ish spring: small tank, splashy top, 22–40 ms drip delay, decay 0.26–0.48, damp 0.16–0.3. Not a plate and not a hall.

presets.name: FET Peak Catch
presets.purpose: Insert on a lead vocal. Fast FET catches peaks. Mix 100.

presets.name: Opto Leveler
presets.purpose: Insert after a peak catcher. Slow opto rides the level. Mix 100.

presets.name: Serial Vocal Stack
presets.purpose: Classic FET into opto on one insert. Lead vocal, Mix 100.

presets.name: Rap Punch Chain
presets.purpose: Rap vocal insert: 80 Hz cut, fast FET, de-ess on the air band. Mix 100.

presets.name: De-Ess Shelf
presets.purpose: Insert de-ess: only the top band is compressed. Mix 100.

presets.name: Slap And Booth
presets.purpose: Vocal send: 95 ms slap plus a small booth. Blend is wet. Mix 25–40 on a send.

presets.name: Dotted Eighth Throw
presets.purpose: Pop vocal throw. Dotted 1/8, dark. Use as a send, Mix 20–35.

presets.name: Quarter Note Halo
presets.purpose: Ballad vocal send. Straight 1/4, wider and wetter than the dotted throw.

presets.name: Dual Throw Lattice
presets.purpose: Two throws: dotted 1/8 left-ish and 1/4. Pop chorus send.

presets.name: Radio Band Vocal
presets.purpose: AM radio vocal. Tight band, light crush, then LPF. Insert or send.

presets.name: Telephone Cup
presets.purpose: Narrower than Radio Band. 400–3 kHz cup, diode grit.

presets.name: Haas Vocal Double
presets.purpose: Mono vocal to a tight double. Mid stays the dry word. Insert, Mix 100.

presets.name: Air Only Vocal
presets.purpose: Add air without more compression. High shelf + tiny tube. Insert.

presets.name: Presence Pocket
presets.purpose: 3 kHz pocket so the lyric cuts a dense mix. Light glue after.

presets.name: Breath Gate
presets.purpose: Close-mic vocal. Gate the breaths, keep the line. Mix 100.

presets.name: Choir Widen Hall
presets.purpose: Stack or choir. Width then a long hall on a send blend.

presets.name: Shout Clip Vocal
presets.purpose: Screamed / shouted vocal. HPF, soft-pre hard ceiling, dark recovery.

presets.name: Narration Seat
presets.purpose: Spoken word / VO. Gentle EQ, slow leveler, peak limit. Mix 100.

presets.name: Mid Word Side Bloom
presets.purpose: MS vocal: mid stays dry words, sides get a short bloom.

presets.name: Vocal Plate Throw
presets.purpose: Short bright plate on a send. Not a hall.

presets.name: Side Air Only
presets.purpose: MS: lift air on the sides only. Center stays put.

presets.name: Parallel Vocal Smash
presets.purpose: NY vocal: dry word plus a smashed bus. Blend is the smash.

presets.name: Track Then Slap
presets.purpose: Insert EQ/comp plus a dedicated slap send in one preset.

presets.name: Talk Formant
presets.purpose: Envelope moves a bandpass so the mouth shape talks. Creative insert.

presets.name: Widen Then Slap
presets.purpose: Double first, then a short slap on the wide image.

presets.name: Air Band Polish
presets.purpose: Crossover: compress the air band and add a silk shelf there only.

presets.name: Pop Lead Desk
presets.purpose: Full pop insert: HPF, FET, de-ess, slap send. Mix 100, send is built in.

presets.name: Intimate Whisper
presets.purpose: Close whisper: high HPF, gentle gate, warm tube, no slap.

presets.name: Green Mid Into Amp
presets.purpose: TS mid-hump into a soft tube stage and vintage cab. Rhythm DI.

presets.name: Tall Stack Fuzz
presets.purpose: Muff-like stacked filters around a fold, then a dark cab.

presets.name: Scooped Rhythm Wall
presets.purpose: High-gain rhythm: tight HPF, 400 Hz scoop, gate, American cab.

presets.name: Tight Gate Lead
presets.purpose: Single-note lead: faster gate, 3.5 kHz presence, British cab.

presets.name: Edge Of Breakup
presets.purpose: One soft tube, no cab IR. Dynamic clean-to-crunch for pickers.

presets.name: Vibe Rotary Guitar
presets.purpose: optical vibe cousin: AM plus a sweeping bandpass. Slow rotary.

presets.name: Country Slap Guitar
presets.purpose: Tele / country: clean tube, 95 ms slap, light spring.

presets.name: Surf Spring Crash
presets.purpose: Splashier spring than Clean Spring Send. More drip, more HPF.

presets.name: Jazz Box Warm
presets.purpose: Hollow-body jazz: low cut gentle, dark LPF, tiny tube, no IR.

presets.name: Metal Scoop Cab
presets.purpose: Modern metal: 90 Hz tight, 400 scoop, 1.5 kHz bark, dark cab.

presets.name: British Crunch Stack
presets.purpose: Two British-voiced tubes, 800 Hz bark, no American scoop.

presets.name: American Clean Cab
presets.purpose: Open-cab cousin with IR. Brighter and more open than Edge Of Breakup.

presets.name: Lead Presence Stack
presets.purpose: Lead: 4 kHz shelf, slower gate, medium cab. Sings above a rhythm wall.

presets.name: Rhythm Mid Scoop
presets.purpose: Palm-mute rhythm. Deeper 280 Hz scoop than Scooped Rhythm Wall, less gain.

presets.name: Single Coil Bright
presets.purpose: Strat / tele: 5 kHz silk, light breakup, vintage cab.

presets.name: Humbucker Thick
presets.purpose: LP / humbucker: 200 Hz body, darker LPF, British cab.

presets.name: Acoustic Sim Box
presets.purpose: Electric to faux-acoustic: notch body, high bandpass, tiny room.

presets.name: Twelve String Chorus
presets.purpose: Short stereo chorus + sparkle shelf. 12-string illusion.

presets.name: Slide Dirt Bed
presets.purpose: Slide guitar: long sustain tube, dark, small room, no gate.

presets.name: Ambient Swell Guitar
presets.purpose: Volume-swell pad: slow env opens a hall. Post-rock.

presets.name: Volume Bloom Lead
presets.purpose: Env swells a tube lead into a short plate. Cinematic lead.

presets.name: Pick Attack Bass
presets.purpose: Env boosts 2 kHz click on picked bass. Insert.

presets.name: Fretless Warm Bass
presets.purpose: Dark LPF, slow opto, no click. Fretless / synth bass.

presets.name: Synth Sub Round
presets.purpose: 808 / sine sub: HPF 25, soft clip, tiny even harmonics.

presets.name: Slap Bass Pop
presets.purpose: Slap bass: 3 kHz pop, fast FET, high HPF.

presets.name: Bass Amp Cab Only
presets.purpose: No extra clip: just HPF, British cab, gentle LPF.

presets.name: Sidechain Duck Bass
presets.purpose: Bass ducks from the host sidechain (kick). Mix 100.

presets.name: Octave Dirt Bass
presets.purpose: Sub octave then a tight tube. Not Precision Octaver alone.

presets.name: Mute Click Bass
presets.purpose: Palm-mute bass: gate + 1.2 kHz click, no cab.

presets.name: Motown Bass Round
presets.purpose: Round fingerstyle: 100 Hz bump, slow comp, vintage cab.

presets.name: Foldback Bass Dark
presets.purpose: Darker foldback bass cousin: more 200 Hz, less top, medium cab.

presets.name: Sub Only Octave
presets.purpose: Just the analog sub, no dry. Bass / guitar. Mix to taste in the host.

presets.name: Octave Into Dirt
presets.purpose: Octave then diode. Synth-bass / riff.

presets.name: Vocoder Formant Shift
presets.purpose: Vocoder as a formant color, self if no sidechain. Voice / synth.

presets.name: Vocoder Talk Box
presets.purpose: Narrower, more mouth. Sidechain voice recommended.

presets.name: Bass Synth Stack
presets.purpose: Sub octave + fold + LPF. Acid / reese cousin, not Acid Hash.

presets.name: Dub Feedback Cave
presets.purpose: High feedback, dark, then a tiny room. Dub send.

presets.name: Vocal Plate Short
presets.purpose: Bright short plate. Lead vocal send.

presets.name: De-Ess Wide
presets.purpose: Broad upper-band de-essing for speech and harsh voices. BandHz can reach down into the presence region; compare consonant clarity while adjusting the threshold.

presets.name: Vocal Opto Soft
presets.purpose: Softer than optical leveler stock. Low ratio, long release.

presets.name: FET Then Opto
presets.purpose: Fast peak compression followed by slower soft-knee leveling. Two timing behaviors, not a hardware circuit emulation. Set thresholds for the input recording.

presets.name: Formant Vowel
presets.purpose: Two formant peaks. Voice / synth.

presets.name: Loudness Clip Master
presets.purpose: Soft-pre clip then limit. Not Loudness Clip stock.

presets.name: British Plexi Bark
presets.purpose: British plexi bark: 800 Hz mid peak, dual tube, cabinet IR.

presets.name: Tweed Edge
presets.purpose: Small tweed: loose low, early breakup, vintage cab.

presets.name: Filter Dist Amp
presets.purpose: RAT filter into a tube stage + medium cab.

presets.name: Fuzz Into Amp
presets.purpose: Stacked-filter fuzz into a dark cab.

presets.name: Crunch Rhythm Pedal
presets.purpose: Medium crunch, 1.2 kHz, no IR.

presets.name: Lead Satin Clip
presets.purpose: Smoother lead clip + presence, no gate.

presets.name: Vocal Tube Desk
presets.purpose: Vocal: tiny tube, HPF 80, no cab.

presets.name: Drum Clip Bus
presets.purpose: Drum bus clip, 80 HPF, 6 kHz LPF.

presets.name: Mixbus Satin
presets.purpose: Mixbus: barely-there tube + limit.

presets.name: Lo-Fi Amp Sim

presets.name: Hard Clip Club

presets.name: Gabber Mid Bark

presets.name: Acid Soft Slide

presets.name: Industrial Chop

presets.name: Hoover Fold Club

presets.name: Rave Stab Desk
presets.purpose: Stab: fast env LPF + clip.

presets.name: Club Mono Kick

presets.name: Supersaw Glue
presets.purpose: Widen + light OTT + clip. Leads / stacks.

presets.name: Drop Impact FX

presets.name: Sidechain Pad EDM
presets.purpose: Four-on-the-floor duck.

presets.name: Reese Mid Growl
presets.purpose: Mid grit + chorus. Bass reese.

presets.name: Festival Group Vocal
presets.purpose: Gang vocal: widen + short slap + OTT.

presets.name: Festival Lead Clip
presets.purpose: Lead: clip + 3 kHz + widen.

presets.name: Festival Drum Bus
presets.purpose: EDM drum bus: OTT + clip + HPF.

presets.name: Tape Hiss Bed
presets.purpose: Dark LPF + wow. Not Cassette.

presets.name: AM Radio Narrow
presets.purpose: Narrower than Phone Line. 500–2.8 kHz.

presets.name: VHS Tracking
presets.purpose: Wow + dark + tiny crush. Video tape.

presets.name: Broken Speaker
presets.purpose: 300–2.5 kHz + fold.

presets.name: Dusty Vinyl Bed
presets.purpose: Notch + dark + gentle clip. Not Vinyl Dirt.

presets.name: Pocket Recorder
presets.purpose: 8 kHz LPF, light crush, HPF 120.

presets.name: Telephone Then Room
presets.purpose: Phone band plus a cheap room.

presets.name: Pad Cloud Hall
presets.purpose: Long hall + slow chorus. Pads.

presets.name: Drone Low Bed
presets.purpose: Dark drone: LPF + long verb + octave sub.

presets.name: Distant Radio Amb
presets.purpose: Bandpass + long verb. Memory / flashback.

presets.name: Impact Body Boom
presets.purpose: Impact: sub bump + short clip. Not Boom Tail.

presets.name: Dialogue Phone
presets.purpose: Phone filter for dialogue. Not Dialogue Seat.

presets.name: Tension Pulse
presets.purpose: Slow trem + dark hall. Not Tension Bed.

presets.name: Score String Hall
presets.purpose: Strings: long hall, no octave. Not Score Hall.

presets.name: Trailer Whoosh
presets.purpose: HPF sweep + short verb. Whoosh / fly-by.

presets.name: Horror Low Drone
presets.purpose: Sub + dark verb. Horror bed.

presets.name: Dialogue Air Seat
presets.purpose: Dialogue: HPF 80, air, tiny booth.

presets.name: Glitch Hold Gate
presets.purpose: Choppy gate, 1/16. Not Glitch Gate.

presets.name: Alien Formant
presets.purpose: Moving formant. Not Alien Ring.

presets.name: Ring Then Verb
presets.purpose: Ring mod into a hall.

presets.name: Cascade Taps
presets.purpose: Three delay times stacked. Not Cascade Loop Dirt.

presets.name: Impact Designer
presets.purpose: Design hits: clip, sub, short room.

presets.name: Texture Crush
presets.purpose: Crush + bandpass. Texture layer.

presets.name: Sub Drop FX
presets.purpose: Octave sub + clip. Drop FX.

presets.name: Glitch Buffer
presets.purpose: Tiny delay, square AM. Buffer glitch.

presets.name: Acoustic Body
presets.purpose: Adds low-mid body to piezo and thin acoustics.

presets.name: Arp Shimmer
presets.purpose: Sparkle for arpeggios and sequences.

presets.name: Bitcrush Glitch
presets.purpose: Digital glitch and bit reduction.

presets.name: Blues Break OD
presets.purpose: Warm mid-forward overdrive for single coils.

presets.name: Chug Palm Mute
presets.purpose: Punchy low-mid for rhythm riffs.

presets.name: Dark Atmosphere
presets.purpose: Low ominous atmosphere layer.

presets.name: Drum Bus Glue
presets.purpose: Gentle bus compression for cohesion.

presets.name: Harmonic Exciter
presets.purpose: Exciter-Charakter über Filter + Sättigung.

presets.name: Loudness Safe
presets.purpose: Controlled saturation with soft clip ceiling.

presets.name: Low End Control
presets.purpose: Tames boomy low end on mixes.

presets.name: Metal Scoop
presets.purpose: Tight high-gain with scooped mids.

presets.name: Pick Attack
presets.purpose: Enhances pick/pluck transients.

presets.name: Pluck Bite
presets.purpose: Short transient emphasis for plucks.

presets.name: Podcast Voice
presets.purpose: Broadcast-style compression and tone.

presets.name: Riff Sustain
presets.purpose: Singing sustain for leads.

presets.name: Sub Weight
presets.purpose: Adds controlled sub and tight low end.

presets.name: Tape Wobble
presets.purpose: Slow pitch/wow flutter.

presets.name: Telephone EQ
presets.purpose: Bandpass 300-3400 Hz für Telefoncharakter.

presets.name: Vocal De-Ess
presets.purpose: Split-band de-esser. Frequency selects the sibilance boundary; Depth lowers the upper-band threshold and increases its ratio. The vocal body remains uncompressed. Start around 5.5 kHz and set Depth by the recording.

presets.name: Vocal Double
presets.purpose: Subtle detune/double thickness.

presets.name: Vocal Presence
presets.purpose: Broad presence lift with gentle peak control. Preserves the full vocal spectrum; use Amount sparingly on already bright microphones.

presets.name: Vocal Warmth
presets.purpose: Broad low-mid warmth with a small parallel saturation contribution. Retains consonants and air instead of band-passing the entire voice.

presets.name: Vowel Filter
presets.purpose: Two parallel formant bands with independent spacing. Vowel moves the lower formant, Spread separates the upper one, and Res controls both bandwidths.

presets.name: 909 Newstyle
presets.purpose: 909 kick to new-style hardcore: click HPF, 320 Hz scooped, env-bricked mids, side scream, tight tube sub. Insert on the kick, Mix 100.

presets.name: Crisp Brick
presets.purpose: Extreme crisp distortion: transient-weighted diode into a low ceiling, then a hard recovery LPF. Kicks, hats, stabs.

presets.name: Techno Snap
presets.purpose: Transient designer for techno: fast peak punch vs slower RMS body. Kicks, hats, claps, stabs.

presets.name: Side Scream
presets.purpose: Mid stays punchy. Side is env-crushed diode so width bites without wrecking the kick center.

presets.name: Offbeat Gallop
presets.purpose: Hard techno rumble: punchy dry kick, dotted-16th dark delay plus hall on a low bus, tube density, env-ducked so the click stays clean. Insert on the kick.

presets.name: Schranz Multiband
presets.purpose: Hardcore kick split: tape-ish sub, 8-bit mid bark into diode, folded click on top, then a brick. Insert on the kick.

presets.name: Downtuned Stack Cab
presets.purpose: Triode pre into a British mid stack, pentode-ish second tube, cab IR, then a dark shelf. Insert on a DI guitar.

presets.name: Streaming Ceiling
presets.purpose: Mixbus density: 25 Hz cut, 60 Hz boost with a 220 Hz scoop, VCA glue, 3 kHz presence, then a soft-knee ceiling. Insert on the mix.

presets.name: FET All In
presets.purpose: FET smash: 20:1-ish, hair-trigger attack, short release, tube grit. Drums, vocals, whole buses.

presets.name: Precision Multiband
presets.purpose: Three-band control: pinned low, lifted mid, tamed air. Insert on a mix or bus.

presets.name: British Desk EQ
presets.purpose: Channel desk: 50 Hz cut, 110 Hz shelf, proportional mid bell, fixed 12 kHz air, light transformer tube.

presets.name: Passive Low Trick
presets.purpose: Passive low trick: boost and cut at 30-60 Hz so the fundamental rises and 200 Hz scoops. Tube makeup, broad air.

presets.name: Ladder Sweep
presets.purpose: Near-oscillation ladder: LFO walks a 4-pole-ish LPF from a floor up, diode polish. For pads, leads, risers.

presets.name: Octave Cloud
presets.purpose: Shimmer: 500 ms delay, octave-up in the wet, damped hall. Dry stays put.

presets.name: Blackwall Space
presets.purpose: Cyberpunk wreck: fold, slow bandpass sweep, huge hall, opto-ish pump. For vocals, synths, field recordings.

presets.name: Click Sustain
presets.purpose: Differential transient: fast peak vs slow RMS. Attack clicks up, body ducks. Kicks, hats, claps.

presets.name: Resonant Lead Screamer
presets.purpose: Hardstyle screaming lead: swept resonant peak before tube distortion, LFO-driven scream band 300-2400 Hz.

presets.name: Peak Screamer
presets.purpose: Fixed scream peak into tube, then a tone lowpass. Not the swept Resonant Lead Screamer.

presets.name: Hyper Cyberpunk Sweep
presets.purpose: Breaks/electro: dual bandpass (static + LFO-swept), asymmetric tube+diode, bitcrush on swept path, metallic comb.

presets.name: Speaking Bass
presets.purpose: Dubstep talking bass: three formant peaks (120/680/1800 Hz) LFO-modulated simultaneously, soft-then-hard ceiling, clean sub bus.

presets.name: Hardstyle Tail Screech
presets.purpose: Resonant hardstyle hardstyle: envelope-controlled resonance intensity, highpass sweep 800-3200 Hz, tube + hardclip + resonant peak.

presets.name: Acid Morph 303
presets.purpose: Classic 303: diode pre-distortion, swept resonant LPF 120-2400 Hz, accent via envelope increases resonance on transients.

presets.name: Frequency Assassin
presets.purpose: Industrial smash: three notch filters with inverse LFO sweeps cut 200-1800 Hz, remaining spectrum through fuzz + fold, rhythmic gate.

presets.name: CTZ Kick Master
presets.purpose: Hardstyle/hardcore clip-to-zero: transient hard-clip 0.72, 3-band split (sub clean, mid soft-clip, high hard-clip), minimal final limiter.

presets.name: Loudness Wall
presets.purpose: Club mastering: four-stage clipping cascade (source clip + tube + multiband soft-clip + master soft + limiter), 8× OS recommended.

presets.name: Brickwall Techno
presets.purpose: Schranz/techno: aggressive per-band limiting (low compress 8:1, mid tube+hard, high transient clip), merge then glue comp + limiter.

presets.name: Master Bus Destroyer
presets.purpose: Industrial/club: parallel distortion (clean 60-85% + slammed 15-40%), OTT density, final limiter with stereo widener before.

presets.name: Midtempo Pressure Pump
presets.purpose: Midtempo 110-130 BPM: triangle LFO (1/8 sync) modulates filter cutoff/reso/drive, asymmetric fold, noise injection, counter-pump sidechain.

presets.name: Midtempo Pump
presets.purpose: Tempo-synced level pump into a lowpass. Not the filter-chaos of Midtempo Pressure Pump.

presets.name: Broken Grid Chaos
presets.purpose: Experimental glitch: S&H square LFO drives random filter jumps, stepped bitcrush modulation, feedback-modulated delay, asymmetric fold + gate.

presets.name: Chaos Grid
presets.purpose: Short grid delay into a filtered crush. Not the sample-and-hold jumps of Broken Grid Chaos.

presets.name: Pulsing Electro
presets.purpose: Two tempo-synced oscillators drive a smooth amplitude pump, moving low-pass emphasis and clipped stutter. Pulse Depth sets the audible pumping amount; no free-running noise is added.

presets.name: Vital Saw Morph
presets.purpose: Synthwave/future bass: asymmetric saw via fold+tube, phase dispersion dual delay, triangle LFO sweeps highshelf, chorus width, light comp.

presets.name: Hard Groove Machine
presets.purpose: Hard dance/hardstyle: square LFO (1/8 sync) gates signal on/off, tube+resonant bandpass when open, reverb tail when closed, transient punch.

presets.name: Resonant Sweep Stab
presets.purpose: Trance/hard trance: envelope follower controls filter cutoff 150-4500 Hz, LFO saw adds sweep, velocity-sensitive resonance Q 0.7-5.5, stereo widener.

presets.name: Kick Surgery
presets.purpose: Hardstyle/rawstyle kick: 3-band crossover (sub sine+comp, punch tube+320Hz notch, click transient+air shelf), phase-aligned merge, final limiter -0.3dB.

presets.name: Hardstyle Sub Pummel
presets.purpose: Hardstyle mid punch with a separately compressed sub path and optional external-sidechain ducking. Sub Delay is a short timing offset in milliseconds, not a phase-angle control.

presets.name: Industrial Split Authority
presets.purpose: Industrial techno hardcore: amplitude split (quiet<-18dB reverb+chorus, medium -18to-6dB tube, loud>-6dB brick+transient), crossfade recombine.

presets.name: Split Authority
presets.purpose: Crossover split: the low stays clean, the high takes the drive. Not the loudness gates of Industrial Split Authority.

presets.name: Multiband Phase Lock
presets.purpose: Club/techno: 4-band split (sub 30-80Hz, low 80-250Hz, mid 250-2500Hz, high 2500+Hz), independent matched comp, soft-limit all to -0.5dB, merge.

presets.name: Reese Razor Mid
presets.purpose: Drum and bass Reese midrange sculptor: clean original under a driven band-limited mid bus. Use a source with its own sub; high-pass the dirty branch to keep sub clean.

presets.name: Reese Formant Strike
presets.purpose: Moving formant emphasis on a band-limited Reese midrange while the original low end stays present. Moderate modulation helps retain note definition.

presets.name: Reese Knife Edge
presets.purpose: High-frequency Reese texture with clipped edge and a steep sub-safe band limit. Blend with an untreated fundamental.

presets.name: Bass Fractionator
presets.purpose: Neurofunk/DnB: sub pure sine phase-locked, body 100-400Hz formant filter, grit 400-1200Hz bitcrush+fold, air 1200+Hz transient, envelope alignment.

presets.name: DnB Snare Needle
presets.purpose: Snare transient bite for drum and bass with upper-mid crack and short controlled sustain. Works on individual snares or isolated snare layers.

presets.name: DnB Break Snap Bus
presets.purpose: Break bus with transient emphasis, restrained glue and parallel saturation for lively, precise breaks. Reduce the parallel blend if hats become brittle.

presets.name: Surgical Snare Designer
presets.purpose: Multiband transient shaper: 3-band xover (low sustain cut 200-300Hz, mid 300-1500Hz snap boost, high 1500+Hz air), envelope per band, glue comp.

presets.name: Depth Sculptor
presets.purpose: Psychoacoustic depth: 2-band xover 400Hz (low immediate, high delayed 5-25ms for 3D layback), crossfeed, soft reverb, slight detuning via chorus.

presets.name: Multiband Punch Enhancer
presets.purpose: Master bus: 4-band transient processing (sub sub-bass tight, low punch boost, mid clarity, high sparkle), OTT gentle drive, soft limiter -0.3dB.

presets.name: Dynamic Space Former
presets.purpose: Ambient/pads: 3-band envelope-based expansion (low slow bloom, mid fast decay, high shimmer tail), hall reverb, soft chorus, gentle comp.

presets.name: Metal Percussion
presets.purpose: SWARM industrial percussion: bitcrush transients only, metallic comb delays (59Hz, 83Hz), resonant peak 1200Hz, envelope-based fold, HPF, limiter.

presets.name: Field Recording Glitch
presets.purpose: Granular-approximation: 6 parallel short delays 15-85ms with random feedback 0.2-0.5, slight pitch detune -3 to +5 semitones, LPF 7500Hz, reverb tail.

presets.name: Downtuned Guitar Industrial
presets.purpose: DJ Hyper 8-string downtuned guitar: HPF 82Hz (low E), heavy comp 8:1, tube+fold chain, resonant 150Hz body, soft-limit -0.45dB. (IR optional in user path)

presets.name: Chaotic Stab Generator
presets.purpose: Techno chaos stab: random pitch shifts -7 to +7 semitones via dual pitch blocks, resonant BP sweep 400-2400Hz LFO, fold+bitcrush 6-bit, gate, limiter.

presets.name: Granular Smear
presets.purpose: Ambient granular texture: 6 parallel delays 25-150ms detune -4/+4 semitones, soft LFO sweep each delay time, hall reverb 0.8 decay, soft-limit -0.5dB.

presets.name: Metal Kick Beater
presets.purpose: Close-miked kick attack with a restrained low-mid cut, beater presence and parallel edge. Gate threshold depends on bleed; inspect individual hits.

presets.name: Metal Snare Crack
presets.purpose: Tight snare body with a sharp upper-mid strike and controlled sustain. Set the gate from the actual snare recording and check ghost notes.

presets.name: Metal Toms Controlled
presets.purpose: Close-miked tom control with adjustable ring reduction and a softened gate tail. Tune the ring frequency by ear for each tom.

presets.name: Metal Drum Bus Impact
presets.purpose: Drum bus glue with slow attack to retain stick and beater transients, modest low-mid shaping and gentle peak control. Keep cymbals out of harsh clipping.

presets.name: Metal Cymbal Tamer
presets.purpose: Overhead control with gentle harshness cut and optional top-end reduction. Does not use a gate, which would chop decays.

presets.name: Blastbeat Front Edge
presets.purpose: Fast/slow envelope contrast emphasizes stick attack while the Sustain control reduces the space between hits. Short detector recovery suits blastbeats; set Gate for the actual recording. Insert on close drums, not cymbal overheads.

presets.name: Snare Steel Crack
presets.purpose: Parallel high-mid saturation adds a metallic crack without distorting the entire drum body. Crack controls the parallel amount; Snap sets its upper bite. Keep the return below the dry snare on dense blastbeats.

presets.name: Growl Iron Throat
presets.purpose: Parallel chest and formant grit for recorded growls. The dry voice remains intelligible; the distorted band avoids subsonic breath noise and high-frequency fizz. Adjust Gate before increasing Rage.

presets.name: Deathwall Tight Stack
presets.purpose: High-gain DI rhythm amp: tight pre-distortion bass, two saturation stages, focused pick mids and a full cabinet IR. Gate tracks palm-mute gaps; Tone controls post-cab fizz. Start from a clean guitar DI.

presets.name: Baritone Serrated Stack
presets.purpose: A raspier baritone DI amp with asymmetric diode saturation, lean low mids and a British cabinet. Distinct from the tight rhythm stack: stronger upper harmonics and a coarse edge. Increase Body only after tuning the gate.

presets.name: Ironclad Split Bass
presets.purpose: Clean compressed fundamentals below the crossover, aggressive cabinet-filtered mids above it. Grind drives only the upper band, keeping the bass weight distinct from guitar distortion. Crossover changes the clean/dirty boundary.

presets.name: Forge Kick Overdrive
presets.purpose: Focused hard-techno kick distortion with a protected low band and a dense, biting upper body. Impact boosts the attack before saturation; Weight balances the clean fundamental. Tune the crossover to the kick.

presets.name: Concrete Kick Fracture
presets.purpose: Full-band wavefolding creates a crushed, tearing kick body. A dry parallel path preserves the first hit; the wet path has its own DC and fizz filters. More Fold deliberately changes pitch and timbre, so check against the bass line.

presets.name: Schranz Percussion Furnace
presets.purpose: Dense upper-band percussion grind with the sub band retained. Slow compressor attack keeps the front edge; short release brings up the abrasive sustain. Best on percussion loops and drum buses, with a separate kick/sub balance.

presets.name: Industrial Bass Excision
presets.purpose: A clean sub underneath a moving, folded mid band. Motion changes the distortion emphasis rather than modulating the sub level. Mono input remains mono; use stereo source material when width is wanted.

presets.name: Techno Iron Rumble
presets.purpose: Dirty low-mid techno rumble as a parallel return. Feed a kick or kick send; the high-pass and low-pass bracket the rumble so the main sub stays defined.

presets.name: Techno Rail Drum Bus
presets.purpose: Hard drum bus with subsonic cleanup, moderate glue, parallel midrange clipping. Dial in the clip path to avoid washing out hats and leave output headroom.

presets.name: Motion Blur Rumble Send
presets.purpose: Wet-only rumble return: diffused reverb, slow moving low-mid emphasis, saturation and input-envelope ducking. Send a kick into it and keep the original kick on its own track. Floor removes unusable sub energy; Return controls the tail level.

presets.name: Gated Rumble Machine Send
presets.purpose: Rhythmic wet-only rumble with tempo-locked tremolo and optional external kick ducking. Use on an aux return. With no external sidechain the compressor remains open; rhythmic motion continues from the internal oscillator.

presets.name: Sub Harmonic Translation
presets.purpose: Adds filtered upper harmonics derived from the existing bass, helping it remain audible on small speakers. The original fundamental stays on the dry path. Amount controls perceived bass presence; this does not synthesize a lower octave.

presets.name: Drum Crush Parallel
presets.purpose: A dedicated parallel drum compressor with high-pass cleanup on the crushed path. Attack leaves the dry transient intact and Density blends in sustain. Match perceived level before judging the result.

presets.name: Low Mid Congestion Control
presets.purpose: Three-band compression focused on the low mids. Low and high bands retain the phase-matched crossover response; only the congested middle band is reduced. Tune the boundaries to the source and reduce Amount when the mix loses body.

presets.name: Master Transient Glue
presets.purpose: Gentle slow-attack bus compression with an adjustable threshold and recovery. Intended for modest gain reduction while preserving attacks; no automatic loudness maximization. Match bypass loudness and leave delivery loudness to the final mastering stage.

presets.name: Master Side Low Cleanup
presets.purpose: High-pass filtering only the side channel removes unstable stereo sub energy while retaining the center bass. The side high shelf can soften wide cymbals. Not a loudness enhancer; compare stereo image and mono translation.

presets.name: Reference Master Polish
presets.purpose: Subtle master bus polish: remove subsonic energy, control low-mid buildup, preserve punch, add restrained presence and air, then catch peaks. Match input and output level; verify LUFS and true peak with external meters.

presets.name: Impact Master Finish
presets.purpose: Modern high-energy master finish with restrained low-mid cut, slow-attack glue, controlled soft clipping and final limiter. Raise input only against the source while checking gain reduction, distortion and true peak.
